title: Object Storage: meter quantum
content:
Object Storage meter quantum is defined as follows: Smallest billable primary meter increment in usage unit; positive decimal.

| Contract tier | Meter quantum |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB | meter quantum: 0.000001 GB-month, equivalent to 0.0001 percent of a GB-month |
| Northbridge Object Storage 10 TB | meter quantum: 0.000001 GB-month, equivalent to 0.0001 percent of a GB-month |
| Northbridge Object Storage 25 TB | meter quantum: 0.000001 GB-month, equivalent to 0.0001 percent of a GB-month |
| Northbridge Object Storage 50 TB | meter quantum: 0.000001 GB-month, equivalent to 0.0001 percent of a GB-month |
| Northbridge Object Storage 100 TB | meter quantum: 0.000001 GB-month, equivalent to 0.0001 percent of a GB-month |
